definitionStageRequirements.note: Create only when the real deterministic lookup wrapper is deployed; never label current opaque agent internals instrumented

wrapperSequence: Use ProcessId from intake receipt; intake carries no ContactId
Allocate one stageExecutionId, started eventId and completed eventId before business execution and connector retry boundaries
Record started without contactId; telemetry failure must not retry the business lookup
Execute the actual approved deterministic customer lookup under normal tool authorization
Only exactly one verified eligible Contact result permits completed telemetry with that real contactId; ambiguous/not-found outcomes remain failed or reconcile, never pick the first candidate
Reuse the same stageExecutionId/sourceExecutionId/operation/branch/attempt for completion; retry the exact telemetry request in a fresh API transaction on transient failure
Use existing rfd_RecordEmailProcessEvent with completed Contact reference; native caller rights and explicit customer-resolution capability/identify-stage policy are checked
After the binding receipt, the case workflow may call rfd_LinkEmailProcessCase with actual processId/caseId; incident.customerid must match the bound Contact
Do not infer identity from sender/ReplyTo/subject alone, do not have an LLM decide to log, and do not retry a financial/business operation to repair telemetry
